scope: Preset M reset frame, final cumulative spatial batch; logical layer/family operators, not dispatches or physical weight tiles
mac_formula: M*K*N*instances; padded executed rows; one MAC, not two FLOPs

status_rules.false_enc0: INT8 feasible but not implemented; explicit remaining FP16 matrix
status_rules.false_dynamic: unsupported or unresolved INT8 arithmetic contract; explicit remaining FP16 matrix

q.conversion: existing per-row activation/per-column offline-weight contract; f32 rescale, f16 output

v.conversion: same validated learned-weight contract as q, preserving f16 V output

wo.original: f16 k32 accumulation seeded by res
wo.conversion: whole-K INT32, f32 rescale and original res addition, f16 output

up.weight: chunks [C,32], naturalized offline to [C,4C]; b1 f16 widened to f32
up.original: biased f16 k32 accumulation inside fused Mlp
up.conversion: whole-K INT32, f32 rescale/bias, f16 output; original GeluQ/E4M3 retained

down.original: sequential f16 k32 accumulation seeded by x2
down.conversion: whole-K INT32, f32 rescale and original x2 addition, f16 x2b output

merge.input: Q8 gather of four padded x2b tokens, [M,4C]
merge.weight: natural [4C,NPM] f32 widened E4M3; f16 bias widened f32
merge.original: biased f16 k32 reduction, clamp +/-2pi, plane-major E4M3 output
merge.int8: GPU gather + existing quantizer/up dot4 + original-format merge store
merge.conversion: new bounded layout adapters only; same integer/scaling contract

expand.input: plane-major E4M3 low field, unpacked on GPU to [M,CIN] f16
expand.weight: natural [CIN,4C] f32 widened E4M3; f16 bias widened f32
expand.original: biased f16 k32 Matmul, natural f16 [M,4C] output
expand.conversion: explicit signed-zero-preserving E4M3 unpack; unchanged downstream Prepare

qkt.weight: none; dynamic Q8(Q).T, not an offline weight matrix
qkt.original: 32-product exact sum then biased f16 score
qkt.conversion: unresolved dynamic RHS scales/window layout and score-bias boundary; learned-weight contract cannot be assumed

pv.input: dynamic f16 probabilities P from original softmax
pv.original: 16-product exact sum, f16 then E4M3 output
pv.conversion: unresolved GPU dynamic-column encoding and scale contract for P,V; retain softmax precision explicitly

enc0.weight: blocked E4M3 [128,64] after 4096-byte dither table; f16 bias
enc0.original: four biased f16 k32 steps; clamp and output-channel permutation
enc0.conversion: feasible but missing GPU texture-feature encoder and image-executor/epilogue handoff adapter; no new operator reverse engineering needed

dec0.weight: blocked E4M3 [64,128], only 80 active columns; f16 bias
dec0.original: two biased f16 k32 steps, original nonlinear image epilogue
dec0.conversion: validated fixed GPU prefix; same per-row/per-column scales, f32 rescale/bias and f16 output

non_gemm_exceptions.reason: data-dependent 3x3 Gaussian filtering, pointwise covariance quadratic forms and blending; no learned/dynamic neural GEMM; excluded explicitly from neural MAC denominator
